Maneno Muhimu:
Mnyambuliko,
Vitenzi, Kiafrika, Kimasaaba.
Katika makala hii, mtafiti anaeleza jinsi vitenzi vya lugha za Kiafrika vinavyonyambuliwa na kuleta maana tofauti tofauti.
Anafanya hivyo kwa kurejelea Kimasaaba ambayo ni lugha inayozungumzwa na Wamasaaba nchini Uganda.
Unyambuaji wa vitenzi ni jambo la kawaida na huwa linatekelezwa katika lugha mbalimbali.
Hivyo basi, katika makala hii, mtafiti anaeleza mnyambuliko ya vitenzi katika lugha ya Kimasaaba.
Anawasilisha mkusanyiko wa vitenzi na kueleza jinsi vinavyonyambuliwa na wazungumzaji.
Aidha, mtafiti anaeleza namna vitenzi hivyo vinatumiwa katika sentensi.
Mtafiti anafanya hivi kwa sababu lugha nyingi za Kiafrika hazijatafitiwa na kuna mambo mengi sana mazuri ambayo hayajulikani kwa ulimwengu.
Katika kazi hii, mtafiti anaandika vitenzi mbalimbali katika lugha asili halafu anavitafsiri katika Kiswahili.
Kwenye kazi hii, madhumuni ya utafiti ni kudhihirisha utaratibu wa kunyambua vitenzi katika Kimasaaba.
Pili, kueleza maana tofauti zinazotokana na mnyambuliko ya vitenzi.
Tatu, kuonyesha kuwa Kimasaaba ni lugha inayoendelea kukua kama lugha zingine za Kiafrika.
Mkabala wa utafiti ulikuwa wa nyanjani.
Kwa kutumia mkabala huu, mtafiti alizuru nyanjani ambako aliendeleza mahojiano na wahojiwa wake.
Majibu ya wahojiwa yalijumlisha data ambazo zilihitajika na mtafiti.
Mwishowe, matokeo ya utafiti huu yanaonyesha kuwa Kimasaaba kama lugha nyingine za Kiafrika ina vitenzi vingi sana vinavyonyambuliwa na kwendeleza mazungumzo ya wazungumzaji.

UTANGULIZI
kitaalamu.
Kutokana na upungufu huu, mtafiti aliamua kuendeleza utafiti huu akidhamiria kueleza jinsi mambo yalivyo na Kimasaaba.
Hii ni kwa sababu lugha nyingi ndogo ndogo zimeangamia kwa kukosa kufanyiwa utafiti na zingine bado zinaendelea kuangamia.
MBINU ZA UTAFITI
Kitenzi ni neno linaloeleza hali ya kitendo.
Kitenzi kimoja kinaweza kunyambuliwa na kudhihirisha hali tofauti za vitendo.
Kwa kawaida, kuna hali kama vile hali ya kutenda, kutendeana, kutendwa, kutendeka na kutendesha katika lugha nyingi za Kibantu.
Kwa hiyo, katika kazi hii, mtafiti anaorodhesha vitenzi mbalimbali vya Kimasaaba ambayo ni lugha ya Wamasaaba na kuvitafsiri katika Kiswahili.
Yafaa ikumbukwe mapema kuwa kuna lahaja tofauti tofauti za Kimasaaba.
Kwa hiyo, katika utafiti huu, mtafiti alizingatia lahaja mojawapo ijulikanayo kama ‘Lubuuya.’ Akisha fasiri vitenzi, mtafiti anaeleza utaratibu wa kuvinyambua.
Baada ya kueleza jinsi vitenzi hivyo hunyambuliwa, mtafiti alifafanua namna ambavyo hutumiwa katika sentensi.
Mtafiti anafanya hivyo kwa kuzingatia maelezo ya waandishi mbalimbali kuhusu mnyambuliko wa vitenzi.
Mwishowe, mtafiti anahitimisha kazi yake kwa kutoa maoni yake kuhusu mambo muhimu yenye uhusiano na utafiti.
SUALA LA UTAFITI
Katika kazi hii, mtafiti alitumia mbinu ya mahojiano.
Kwa kutumia mbinu hii, mtafiti alizuru nyanjani ambako alikutana na wahojiwa wake.
Kabla ya mahojiano, mtafiti alieleza wahojiwa wake sababu ya utafiti wake.
Baada ya kufanya hivyo, alianza kuendeleza mahojiano na wahojiwa hao.
Wahojiwa walijumlisha wanawake 50 na wanaume 50.
Mtafiti alihakikisha kuwa kuna idadi sawa ya wanawake na wanaume kutokana na suala la usawa wa kijinsia.
Wahojiwa hawa waliteuliwa kwa kutumia mbinu ya sharabera.
Kwa kutumia mbinu hii, mtafiti aliendeleza mazungumzo na wahojiwa wake kama alivyokutana nao.
Hakutumia utaratibu maalumu kuwateua wahojiwa hao.
Mtafiti alikuwa na mwongozo wa maswali ambayo aliyatumia katika mahojiano.
Mtafiti alitumia mwongozo ili asije akasahau jambo lolote muhimu.
Mijadala iliyoendelezwa ilihusika kwa kiasi kikubwa na mnyambuliko wa vitenzi.
Baada ya kutaja kitenzi, mtafiti aliwauliza namna ya kukinyambua katika hali tofauti tofauti.
Kwa mujibu wa mtafiti, kuna makabila mengi sana barani Afrika.
Kila kabila lina lugha yake asili.
Kwa hiyo, kuna lugha nyingi sana zinazozungumzwa baranani humu.
Hata hivyo, sehemu kubwa ya lugha hizo hazijatafitiwa na kuna mambo mengi sana yanayowasilishwa na lugha hizo ambayo bado hayajajulikana kwa ulimwengu.

Kulingana na maelezo yake, mnyambuliko wa vitenzi hupelekea kitenzi kimoja kuleta maana tofauti tofauti kutokana na hali mbalimbali za mnyambuliko.

ABSTRACT  
15 July 2020  
Keywords:  
Derivation,  
Verbs, African, Masaaba. In this article, the researcher explains how verbs in African languages are derived to convey different meanings. This is done by referring to Masaaba, a language spoken by the Masaaba people in Uganda. Verb derivation is a common phenomenon and is practiced in various languages. Therefore, in this article, the researcher describes the verb derivation process in the Masaaba language. He presents a collection of verbs and explains how speakers derive them. In addition, the researcher discusses how these verbs are used in sentences. The researcher does this because many African languages have not been studied, and there are many fascinating aspects that are unknown to the world. In this work, the researcher writes various verbs in the original language and then translates them into Swahili. The aim of this study is, firstly, to demonstrate the process of verb derivation in Masaaba; secondly, to explain the different meanings that result from verb derivation; and thirdly, to show that Masaaba is a language that continues to grow like other African languages. The research approach was field-based. Using this approach, the researcher visited the field where they conducted interviews with their respondents. The responses of the respondents constituted the data needed by the researcher. In conclusion, the findings of this research indicate that Kimasaaba, like other African languages, has a great number of verbs that are derived and facilitate the speakers’ discourse. Due to this gap, the researcher decided to advance this study with the aim of elucidating the situation in Kimasaaba. This is because many minority languages have become extinct as a result of not being researched, and others are continuing to become extinct. RESEARCH METHODS  
A verb is a word that describes the state of an action. A single verb can be derived and express different states of actions. Typically, there are forms such as the active, reciprocal, passive, stative, and causative in many Bantu languages. Therefore, in this work, the researcher lists various Kimasaaba verbs, which is the language of the Bamasaaba, and translates them into Swahili. It should be noted early on that there are different dialects of Kimasaaba. Therefore, in this research, the researcher focused on a particular dialect known as ‘Lubuuya.’ After translating the verbs, the researcher explains the process of verb derivation. Having described how these verbs are derived, the researcher clarifies how they are used in sentences. The researcher does so by considering the explanations of various authors regarding verb derivation. Finally, the researcher concludes the work by providing his views on important matters related to the research. RESEARCH QUESTION  
In this study, the researcher employed the interview method. Using this approach, the researcher went out into the field to meet the respondents. Before conducting the interviews, the researcher explained to the respondents the purpose of the research. After doing so, the researcher proceeded to conduct interviews with them. The respondents consisted of 50 women and 50 men. The researcher ensured that there was an equal number of women and men due to the issue of gender equality. These respondents were selected using the purposive sampling method. Using this method, the researcher continued conversations with the respondents as he met them. He did not use any special procedure in selecting the respondents. The researcher had a set of questions that he used during the interviews. The researcher used this guide to ensure that he would not forget any important points. The discussions that were conducted largely focused on verb derivation. After mentioning a verb, the researcher asked how to derive it in different contexts. According to the researcher, there are very many ethnic groups in Africa. Each ethnic group has its own indigenous language. Therefore, there are numerous languages spoken across the continent. However, the majority of these languages have not been researched, and there is a great deal that these languages convey which is still unknown to the world. There are very few African languages that have been thoroughly studied.

In grammar, derivation is the ability of a root or stem to be affixed with a morpheme at its beginning or end. The result is to expand the meaning of the given word. This is the function of every affix—to build new roots and stems of words, which are called derivational stems or roots. 15 July 2020  
Keywords:  
Derivation,  
Verbs, African, Masaaba. In this article, the researcher explains how verbs in African languages are derived to convey different meanings. This is done by referring to Masaaba, a language spoken by the Masaaba people in Uganda. Verb derivation is a common phenomenon and is practiced in various languages. Therefore, in this article, the researcher describes the verb derivation process in the Masaaba language. He presents a collection of verbs and explains how speakers derive them. In addition, the researcher discusses how these verbs are used in sentences. The researcher does this because many African languages have not been studied, and there are many fascinating aspects that are unknown to the world. In this work, the researcher writes various verbs in the original language and then translates them into Swahili. The aim of this study is, firstly, to demonstrate the process of verb derivation in Masaaba; secondly, to explain the different meanings that result from verb derivation; and thirdly, to show that Masaaba is a language that continues to grow like other African languages.

MBINU ZA UTAFITI
Kitenzi ni neno linaloeleza hali ya kitendo. Kitenzi kimoja kinaweza kunyambuliwa na kudhihirisha hali tofauti za vitendo. Kwa kawaida, kuna hali kama vile hali ya kutenda, kutendeana, kutendwa, kutendeka na kutendesha katika lugha nyingi za Kibantu. Kwa hiyo, katika kazi hii, mtafiti anaorodhesha vitenzi mbalimbali vya Kimasaaba ambayo ni lugha ya Wamasaaba na kuvitafsiri katika Kiswahili. Yafaa ikumbukwe mapema kuwa kuna lahaja tofauti tofauti za Kimasaaba. Kwa hiyo, katika utafiti huu, mtafiti alizingatia lahaja mojawapo ijulikanayo kama ‘Lubuuya.’ Akisha fasiri vitenzi, mtafiti anaeleza utaratibu wa kuvinyambua. Mtafiti anafanya hivyo kwa kuzingatia maelezo ya waandishi mbalimbali kuhusu mnyambuliko wa vitenzi. Mwishowe, mtafiti anahitimisha kazi yake kwa kutoa maoni yake kuhusu mambo muhimu yenye uhusiano na utafiti.

RESEARCH METHODS  
A verb is a word that describes the state of an action. A single verb can be derived and express different states of actions. Typically, there are forms such as the active, reciprocal, passive, stative, and causative in many Bantu languages. Therefore, in this work, the researcher lists various Kimasaaba verbs, which is the language of the Bamasaaba, and translates them into Swahili. It should be noted early on that there are different dialects of Kimasaaba. Therefore, in this research, the researcher focused on a particular dialect known as ‘Lubuuya.’ After translating the verbs, the researcher explains the process of verb derivation. Having described how these verbs are derived, the researcher clarifies how they are used in sentences. The researcher does so by considering the explanations of various authors regarding verb derivation. Finally, the researcher concludes the work by providing his views on important matters related to the research.

Based on his explanation, verb derivation allows a single verb to generate multiple different meanings depending on the various types of derivation applied. Baraka (2018) advanced his research by referring to the Kinyakyusa language, which is his mother tongue. He emphasizes that this language has a great many verbs that are amenable to derivation. discourses.translated_txt: Kihore and colleagues (2003) divide verbs into three main types: the main verb (T), the auxiliary verb (Ts), and the participial verb (t). They explain that a main verb is a verb that can appear independently in a sentence and complete the meaning on its own.

discourses.translated_txt: We see here that: (i) -pig- is the root of the word tutampiganisha. (ii) tu-ta-m- are the affixes that come before the root –pig-. (iii) –an-ish-a are the affixes that come after the root –pig-. The prefixes and suffixes of the root -pig- give different meanings, as follows: (i) The prefix tu- indicates first person plural (we). (ii) The prefix -ta- indicates future tense. (iii) The prefix -m- refers to the object, third person singular (him/her). (iv) The affix -an- indicates reciprocity. (v) The affix –ish- is the causative marker. (vi) The affix -a is for finalizing the verb form. (b) Derivational or formative affixes normally occur at the end of the stem of the word.

Mbwillow (2017) explains that words in human languages are formed in various ways. He mentions methods such as reduplication, coining, compounding, and affixation, referring specifically to inflection and derivation. He explains that affixation is the process of attaching or adding morphemes or affixes before or after the root, core, or stem of a word. He emphasizes that the main methods of word formation are inflection and derivation. He defines derivation as the process of attaching morphemes/affixes after the root and stem of a word. In his work, he states that inflection and derivation form new words. He clarifies that inflection and derivation may not necessarily change the word class but rather expand the meaning of the word in question. This includes the possibility for the action of a verb to be possible, for example: someka, imbika, ombeka, fungika.

discourses.translated_txt: The writings of various scholars demonstrate that a verb is a word that expresses an action, whereas derivation is the process of adding affixes to a verb to generate new words with different meanings.
